$description: Every animation on the live site (21 Nov 2026), found by scanning all 16 pages at 1440 and 390. Each entry: what moves and when, the CSS animations measured in the browser, the source files that build it, and a viewer that runs it alone with the site's own code (serve the repo root, then open design-system/motion/view.html).

global.name: Coral ink in headings
global.what: The coral second part of a two-part heading carries a slow moving gradient.

global.name: Entrance
global.what: Sections and their blocks fade and rise into place once, when they come into view.
global.timing: opacity 0.9s + translate 0.9s, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); blocks may stagger

global.name: Button and link hover
global.what: Primary brightens with a coral glow; secondary fills lightly; link warms and its arrow steps up and right.

global.name: Pinned steps
global.what: The section holds; scroll moves the stepper and the preview (desktop: from 901×701; phone: the mobile layer).
global.timing: scroll-linked, 2px track fills with the scroll
